content.title: What time is Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella set? Here's how to watch online
content.text: 10 April 2026, 13:10 | Updated: 10 April 2026, 18:07 Sabrina Carpenter Coachella time and how to watch online. Picture: Getty Sabrina Carpenter is headlining Coachella on Friday April 10th and April 17th but what time is she on stage? She told you she'd come again! Sabrina Carpenter is headlining Coachella...here's how can you watch her set online.Ever since Coachella announced that Sabrina Carpenter would be headlining the 2026 festival, fans have been eager to see her performance and how it compares to her sold out Short n' Sweet Tour. Discussing the show with Perfect, Sabrina said: "It’s the most ambitious show I’ve ever done...we started this process around seven months ago."So what time does Sabrina take to the Coachella stage and how can you watch the livestream? Scroll down to see Sabrina's Coachella set times in the US, UK and other territories around the world so you don't miss a thing.Read more: Sabrina Carpenter Coachella setlist: Every song she performs in order Sabrina Carpenter teases Coachella set How long is Sabrina Carptenter's Coachella set?Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella set is scheduled to be an hour and a half. She will take to the Coachella main stage at 9:05PM (PT) on April 10th and finish at 10:35PM (PT). For fans on the east coast in the US, this means that Sabrina will start performing at 0:05AM (ET) on April 11th and finish at 1:35AM (ET).For viewers in the UK, Sabrina will take to the stage at 5:05AM (BST) and wrap up at 6:35AM (BST) - so set those alarms early. Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella set will start at 9:05PM (PT) on Friday April 10th.What time is Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella set?Here's a list of Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella set times in multiple time zones:United States (PT) - 9:05PMUnited States (ET) - 0:05AM (April 11th)Canada (Vancouver) - 9:05PMCanada (Toronto) - 0:05AM (April 11th)Brazil (Rio De Janiero) - 1:05AM (April 11th)United Kingdom (BST) - 5:05AM (April 11th)Europe (CET) - 6:05AM (April 11th)South Africa (Cape Town, Central Africa Time) - 6:05AM (April 11th)India (New Delhi) - 9:35AM (April 11th)Indonesia (Jakarta) - 11:05AM (April 11th)Philippines (Manila) - 12:05PM (April 11th)Hong Kong - 12:05PM (April 11th)Singapore - 12:05PM (April 11th)Australia (Perth) - 12:05PM (April 11th)Australia (Sydney) - 2:05PM (April 11th)Japan (Tokyo) - 1:05PM (April 11th)New Zealand (Auckland) - 4:05PM (April 11th)Find even more time zones here.How to watch Sabrina Carpenter's Coachella set onlineTo access the Coachella 2026 livestream, there is a Coachella Livestream App you can download from the App Store on your phone. If you fancy watching multiple artists as well as Sabrina, we would recommend downloading the app so you have all the Coachella info you need in one place. However, you can also watch the Coachella 2025 livestream directly on YouTube. Simply go to Coachella's YouTube page where there are livestreams for each stage: Main Stage, Outdoor Theatre, Sahara, Mojave, Gobi and Sonora.You can watch the Main Stage livestream below. Main Stage - Live from Coachella 2026 Full sets will not be uploaded to YouTube after each livestream so make sure to watch your favourite artist live if you want to see their entire show.
